scenarios.name: ASSAULT
scenarios.canon: Seize a jurisdiction from a rival claim while the Vigil treats both sides as unauthorized.

scenarios.name: SWARM
scenarios.canon: Contain a Vigil density surge whose maintenance logic is reproducing faster than either claimant can negotiate.

scenarios.name: OVERRUN
scenarios.canon: Recover a collapsing node after its civil defenses and archive layers have already failed.

scenarios.name: VIGIL / ENDLESS
scenarios.canon: Submit to an open-ended Old Weather audit in which no political victory condition is recognized.

scenarios.name: RENEGADE HUNT
scenarios.canon: Remove an outlaw commander or corrupted claim operating under your own banners credentials.

scenarios.name: SWARM DEFENSE
scenarios.canon: Defend a world you already hold when its legacy enforcement routines reactivate.

scenarios.name: CO-OP REINFORCEMENT
scenarios.canon: Answer an allied request where preserving the partner matters more than replacing their claim.
